name: FaderZero PWA
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install 22.16.0 && nvm alias default 22.16.0 && npm ci && npm run e2e:install

terminals.name: vite-dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 22.16.0 && npm run dev
terminals.description: Vite dev server for the FaderZero PWA on http://localhost:5173
